'''Alumabronze''' was a type of metal alloy typically used in the creation of artistic sculptures.{{Fact}} The doorframes of [[Duttes Mer]]'s office were made from plain, undecorative alumabronze.<ref name="Mindharp of Sharu">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref>
